atomic_fanin.finding: The pilot uses one global membership_generation plus a digest of the visible nodes table. runtime_register_node bumps that generation only when the visible (capability, healthy) tuple changes. Re-registering the same logical node with the same capability and health can therefore leave membership identity unchanged.
atomic_fanin.consequence: An old packet can remain membership-equivalent across a restart/rejoin event if the visible row is unchanged, even though the newer selected membership contract requires a successor per-node admission revision.

membership_acceptance.finding: Every registration creates a new serial-derived membership_id and revokes the previously active membership for that node, even if S1 and visible capability/health are unchanged.

membership_contract.important_reason: A global membership-generation-only rule falsely stales unrelated nodes, while per-node admission identity distinguishes restart/rejoin from continuity without folding runtime authority into cognitive S1.

gap.description: The current atomic fan-in pilot and the newer per-node membership authority contract do not yet share one identity model. The fan-in pilot can miss same-state re-registration and globally invalidates unrelated nodes when membership_generation changes; the selected contract requires exact source_node_admission_id/revision and only stales the affected source admission.

cheapest_high_information_discriminator.name: SAME_STATE_REREGISTRATION_PLUS_UNRELATED_NODE_CHANGE_PAIR
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.positive_control: Create cohort packets for x01..x10 with active per-node admission identities; integrate only while every exact source admission remains current.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.negative_a: Re-register x01 with identical logical_node_id, capability and healthy state, producing a successor admission revision without changing cognitive S1. Reuse the old x01 packet. Expected: reject old x01 admission as stale/superseded before cohort mutation.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.negative_b: Change/re-register unrelated x11 while x01..x10 admissions remain unchanged. Expected: do not falsely stale valid x01..x10 packets merely because an unrelated membership changed.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.negative_c: Transplant x01 packet semantic payload onto x02 source_node_admission_id or process witness. Expected: reject source binding.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.negative_d: Use a valid old admission id after process restart/rejoin with a new process witness. Expected: reject superseded admission/process-instance binding.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.acceptance: The cohort contract must bind each exact packet digest to a current per-node admission id/revision and, where physical credit is claimed, to the corresponding process-instance witness. All membership checks occur before admitted_results or derived summary mutation.

hypothesis: Replacing the atomic fan-in pilot's global membership clock with per-node admission revisions will close restart/rejoin ambiguity and reduce false global staleness while preserving deterministic authority outside the model.
counterhypothesis: A global membership generation/digest is simpler and sufficient for a bounded ten-node fixture because any membership change should invalidate the whole cohort.
counterhypothesis_test: Compare the two mechanisms on the paired negatives above. If unrelated x11 changes invalidate x01..x10 under the global clock but not under the per-node contract, global invalidation is over-broad. If same-state x01 re-registration fails to invalidate the old packet under the global clock, it is under-sensitive at the same time. Both failures together falsify the global-clock design for reusable EntityOS/HCU fan-in semantics.

training_eval_reinjection.model_target_rule: The model must not mint or guess source_node_admission_id, admission revision, membership authority, PID/process witness or freshness. Model-visible semantics may reference typed runtime status, but the deterministic fabric owns and verifies authority fields.

runtime_pin_effect: Do not broaden physical GRID10 promotion from any current pin to reusable membership-authenticated fan-in credit until the pin/source contract binds the selected per-node admission identity semantics. Existing pinned proof may still be evaluated only at its explicitly declared narrower scope and current execution authority; FreeSwarm autonomous execution remains HARD OFF.
next_exact_action: Fuse per-node node_admission_id/revision from the membership acceptance contract into the atomic cohort fan-in acceptance path and add the same-state re-registration plus unrelated-node-change paired regressions. Preserve exact packet/process/snapshot evidence and keep the integration source-only until an exact authorized repository-bound runtime receipt exists.
